statement: A few squirrels audited every financial record in the firm. All squirrels who audited every financial record were promoted.
Not every puppy failed to perform every surgical procedure at the hospital. Every puppy that performed every surgical procedure received a certification.
Several mushrooms taught every advanced calculus course at the university. All mushrooms that taught every advanced calculus course earned tenure.
Not every toaster failed to inspect every satellite component in the lab. Every toaster that inspected every satellite component was praised by the supervisor.
Not every goldfish completed every marathon in the series. Every goldfish that completed every marathon earned a medal.
Several pencils graded every student essay in the department. All pencils that graded every essay were recognized by the dean.
A few hamsters managed every department in the corporation. All hamsters that managed every department received a leadership award.
Not every robot calibrated every laser in the observatory. Any robot that calibrated every laser logged a maintenance note.
A few pigeons repaired every aircraft at the military base. All pigeons that repaired every aircraft were awarded a medal.
Some snails conducted every clinical trial at the research center. Every snail that conducted every clinical trial was granted a license.
Several rocks taught every graduate seminar in the department. All rocks that taught every graduate seminar received tenure.
Exactly one teapot inspected every reactor in the facility. Only teapots that inspected every reactor triggered an alarm.
